items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was a guy named Al Cafagna [correct]. He wasn’t well known. He was a musician. He owned a tenor saxophone. He wasn’t that good a player. He thought, “I might as well let this guy use it.”

ctx.x: There was a guy named Al Cafagna [correct]. He wasn’t well known. He was a musician. He owned a tenor saxophone. He wasn’t that good a player. He thought, “I might as well let this guy use it.”
Somebody use it that could do something with it [laughs].
